Subject: OpticAI POC — notes, actions, and next steps (recap)

Hi all — quick recap from the 6/14 hands-on session and owners for follow-ups. Great session; validated routing, found two prompt cases that needed prefix trimming and one edge case in KV fallback that Dev will address.

Key takeaways:
- Prompt review: we trimmed three prompts (prompt IDs: p-12, p-23, p-55) to reduce token growth; Marissa to own final prompt edits.
- KV routing: fallback on miss sometimes returned a stale item under high concurrency. Root cause is a race when eviction and background refresh overlap — Dev to push a fix and a test by 6/21.
- Load test: 500 rps bursts were within SLO for 95th pct but 99th pct degraded during one burst; Ben to run extended tail analysis and propose kernel-level tuning by 6/22.

Action items (owners & deadlines):
- Sam (OpticAI): confirm sanitized dataset is in the shared drive — due 6/15 (done)
- Marissa (Redwood): final prompt edits and push to test repo — due 6/18
- Dev (Redwood): KV fallback race fix + unit test — due 6/21
- Ben (Redwood): tail-latency analysis and tuning recommendations — due 6/22
- Irene (Redwood): schedule follow-up 90-min session for verification — propose dates by 6/18

Related artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OpticAI-POC (includes logs, prompt diffs, and perf traces).

Next steps: I'll propose two possible slots for the verification session; please reply with availability. If we close items on time we can plan the verification for the week of 6/25.

Thanks everyone for a productive workshop.

Best,
Irene
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
